name: FillRule
brief: Fill rule for determining whether a point is inside a shape.
description: Used to determine which regions should be filled when rendering complex paths with self-intersections or multiple contours.

members.name: Winding
members.brief: Non-zero winding rule (default) - counts the number of times a path winds around a point

members.name: EvenOdd
members.brief: Even-odd rule - alternates between filled and unfilled regions, useful for complex shapes with holes
